# Keep exact localized resource filenames and document links paired

The calendar.properties migration needed followups for a missing calendar-alarms.ftl preferences include and misspelled occurrence prompt resource. Current XHTML references calendar/calendar-occurrence-prompt.ftl exactly. A valid Fluent ID does not help when its file is absent or misspelled at the consumer. Check resource include and installed filename along with ID/arguments when changing localization.

Scope: calendar.
